Hi Lauren,

Thanks for onboarding Redwood — our compliance team has a couple of follow-ups before we finalize our procurement checklist. We received the SOC 2 Type II you uploaded but need three pieces of supplemental evidence tied to controls in the report:

1) MFA enforcement evidence for all human console logins (April–June 2025 window) — we need a log slice showing enforcement events and policy status (okta or IdP).
2) Authn/authz logs (successful + failed interactive logins, token issuance, and admin elevation events) for the same window. CSV or gzipped JSON is fine; anything that includes timestamps, user ids, IPs, and action types.
3) A short bridge letter that explains the audit period coverage and whether any configuration changes occurred after the audit that materially affect control coverage (particularly around session timeout and service account rotation).

Our timeline is tight — would appreciate confirmation of what you can provide by EOD Monday, 14 Jul. If you have a standard redaction or delivery process (S3 presigned, encrypted zip), please let me know. Also confirm whether we need an NDA or BAA signed for the log slice delivery.
